subject: dataTableOutput on Jquery dialog  can't work sometimes

messages.author: 6b6a0612e7e51863
messages.subject: dataTableOutput on Jquery dialog  can't work sometimes
parts:
Hello,

For some reason I need to show my table on a popup dialog, I can't find a dialog widget on shiny Reference page , so I use jquery popup dialog. But, it can't work sometime.

The page I designed have a navibar  with two tabPanel, e.g. "user" panel and "admin" panel, and there is a button on each panel, when I push the button, it will popup the dialog and show a dataTableOutput.
 
The code like:
/////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
///////////////  ui.R
////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
shinyUI(
  navbarPage("ADMIN",id="adm", 
  tabPanel("User",uiOutput("user"),icon=icon("users")),
  tabPanel("Admin",uiOutput("admin"),icon=icon("spinner"))
  )
  )

/////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
///////////////  server.R
////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
shinyUI(
 R.utils::sourceDirectory('func',recursive = TRUE, modifiedOnly=FALSE)
  )

/////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
///////////////  user.R      #under 'func' directory
////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
output$loglist<-renderDataTable(
input$refreshusrtb
userstab                           #I alread load the dataset from another .R file
)

observe({
   input$showusrtb
  session$sendCustomMessage(type="showusersdlg","show") 
})

output$user<-renderUI(fluidPage(style="overflow:visible !important;",
  fluidRow(
    tags$div(id="userdlg",dataTableOutput("usertable")),
        actionButton("showusrtb") ,
        actionButton("refreshusrtb")        
    ),
   tagList(        
         singleton(tags$head(tags$link(rel="stylesheet",href="jq_ui/jquery-ui.min.css"))),
         singleton(tags$head(tags$script(src="jq_ui/external/jquery/jquery.js"))),
         singleton(tags$head(tags$script(src="jq_ui/jquery-ui.min.js"))),
    
         singleton(tags$head(tags$script(src="myuserdialog.js")))
  ))
//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
///////////////  myuserdialog.js
////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

$(document).ready(function(){

  $('#userdlg').dialog({
  autoOpen:false,
     modal:true,
     width:830,
     height:860,
     title:"Administrator activity log",
     buttons:{
                "OK":function(){               
                  $(this).dialog("close");  
                }
               }
  });
 

Shiny.addCustomMessageHandler("adminlogSingle",function(message){

   $("#userdlg").dialog("open");
});
      
});

/////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
#### admin.R
the admin.R is the same structure as user.R
////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////

the problem is if the page is completely loaded, then the userdlg dialog worked well, each time I push "showusrtb" it will show usertable and it will refreshed when "refreshusrtb" button is pushing. 
But when I switch to "Admin" Panel it and push "showadmintb" button the dialog will popup but with no admintb on it(I'm sure the code is correct, if I don't make it show on the dialog the admintable will work )
And, If I switch to "Admin" Panel when it just is loading (when navibar just show out), then the admintb will occur on the popup dialog when "showusrtb" button was pushed, but it will not reactive with the push of  "refreshadmintb",
now I switch back to "User" Panel, the "usertable" will not show on the dialog when it popup.

Any suggestions? 
Thank you so much!!

Best,

CJ

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: dataTableOutput on Jquery dialog can't work sometimes
parts:
Shiny generally tries to figure out what outputs are showing, and what outputs are hidden, at any given moment. Any outputs that are hidden, it knows not to recalculate their values on the server--and then when they are later shown, then they will be recalculated again.

The problem is that there's no reliable way for Shiny to know when JavaScript code alters the DOM in such a way that will cause an output to be shown or hidden. So we use the "shown" and "hidden" events as a clue to go examine each output to see if it's now hidden or visible. Many (most) libraries don't raise these events though, so you often have to insert these calls yourself.
